audience: Stellar DeFi depositors and borrowers participating in pooled lending protocols
problem_statement: Borrowers and lenders in shared pools bear systemic exposure when protocol TVL dwarfs local DEX liquidity, creating severe liquidation contagion risks during pool-wide drawdowns.
angle: With Blend TVL at $157.16M compared to just $1.24M on Soroswap, pooled lending structures on Soroban create outsized contagion risks during liquidation cascades; however, because the provided data is limited to TVL snapshots and a 0.08 ledger capacity without explicit bad debt metrics, our argument must focus strictly on the sheer liquidity imbalance rather than proven insolvencies.
